Name: Impactful - Camera Shake
Author: heyitsmads
Description:
Adds camera shake impact VFX to several actions in Stardew. Fully configurable and performance friendly

[size=4][b]Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Screen shake when shattering boulders, meteorites, etc[/*]
[*]Screen shake when taking damage [/*]
[*]Screen shake when bombs explode, scaling on bomb size and distance from the blast[/*]
[*]Screen shake when felled trees hit the ground and hardwood logs shatter[/*]
[*]Fully configurable[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Should be compatible with just about all mods including those that add custom bombs, large resource clumps, etc as long as they use vanilla item categories[/*]
[*]Compatible with multiplayer — other player's damage, tree chopping, mining, etc do not shake your screen[/*]
[/list]

Manifest.Name: Impactful
Manifest.Description: Restrained camera feedback for impactful Stardew Valley actions.
Manifest.Author: heyitsmads
